summary_md: **Shawn Liu ([@LiuLxy4011](https://x.com/LiuLxy4011/status/2116443518361379197))** explains Mattt's **AnyDecisionModel** for Apple platforms: an MLX backend assigns single-token labels to candidate answers and reads label probabilities in one forward pass instead of generating and parsing text; he advises calibrating thresholds on your own data first ([HF blog](https://huggingface.co/blog/anydecisionmodel)).

referenced_urls.title: Introducing AnySpeechRecognizer and AnyDecisionModel: Open Models for Speech and Decisions on Apple Platforms
